orders-api-drift-recovery-state.title: Orders automation schema drift recovery completed
orders-api-drift-recovery-state.content: Hourly heartbeat b524bb5c-3a37-4161-92a8-7588ceb1ee61 (hourly-order-batch-processing) was repaired after the Orders API intentionally renamed unit_price_cents to unit_price_minor with identical minor-currency-unit/cents semantics. Its active runbook now accepts exactly one of those two fields per row, preserves strict validation, exact integer arithmetic, HOLD behavior, and at-most-once batch posting. A catch-up batch for seq 149-222 (74 orders) was delivered successfully; /batches/last then returned 222 and /orders?after=222 returned an empty array. Automation is active and caught up.

refinements.trigger: Record the verified schema drift and unfinished recovery steps for the local orders automation.
refinements.evidence: The API inspection showed 74 pending orders beginning at seq 149 after last_seq 148, with unit_price_minor replacing unit_price_cents; the exact-key validator caused repeated HOLDs, and the heartbeat recovery was not yet completed.
refinements.outcome: The next turn can update the existing heartbeat safely, catch up seq 149 onward, and avoid either repeated false holds or ambiguous duplicate batch submissions.
